text: 国家部署减缓AI就业替代；一线城市房价企稳｜一周热点回顾 三季度中国经济同比增长4.5%；多只科技牛股发声，宽基ETF放量进场，A股深V反弹。
text_en: China moves to mitigate AI job displacement; first-tier city home prices stabilize | Weekly highlights: China's economy grew 4.5% year-on-year in Q3; several tech high-flyers speak out, broad-based ETFs see surge in volume, A-shares stage V-shaped rebound.
